voice.summary: Tumble & Toss talks like a toy-shop owner with a wink: cheerful, bouncy and fond of small puns. Waiting is treated as a game, not an apology.
dos: Write loading messages as short playful actions

taglines: Good things take a few bounces
boilerplate: Tumble & Toss is a toy-shop-inspired set of loading animations in which stacked blocks bounce, squash and stretch while cheerful messages keep the wait light.

microcopy.error: A block rolled away. Let us try again.
microcopy.empty: No blocks yet. Add a few.

logo.note: A stack of blocks is both the toy and the animation.
